role: cancellation tool the table does not name (terminate: true stops a running exec cell)
source: the parameters Codex 0.166.0 offered its model in a probe session's additional_tools rollout record, recorded by codex/probes/turn-pause-probe.py run surface

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.
